business_summary: Tai Hing Group Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the operation of restaurants and sale of food products in Hong Kong and Macau, and Mainland China. It operates a network of restaurants under Tai Hing, Men Wah Bing Teng, TeaWood, Asam Chicken Rice, Trusty Congee King, Ph? Lê, Tommy Yummy, On Kim Pot Rice, Bashi Ramen, Dimpot, Dumpling Station, King Fong Bing Teng, Bingle Bingle, Tori Yoichi, Hing Gor Beef Brisket, TOKENYO Korean BBQ Cuisine, Sing Kee Seafood Restaurant, ManShan Taipei, Rice Rule, TOKENYO, and other brand names. It also provides catering services, dine-in, takeaway, and food delivery, as well as operates an integrated mobile application, Tai Hing Group App, for digital ordering, membership, and promotions. The company was founded in 1989 and is headquartered in Quarry Bay, Hong Kong. Tai Hing Group Holdings Limited operates as a subsidiary of Chun Fat Company Limited.
business_summary_ko: 투자 지주 회사인 Tai Hing Group Holdings Limited는 홍콩, 마카오, 중국 본토에서 레스토랑 운영과 식품 판매에 종사하고 있습니다. Tai Hing, Men Wah Bing Teng, TeaWood, Asam Chicken Rice, Trusty Congee King, Ph.D.에서 레스토랑 네트워크를 운영하고 있습니다. Lê, Tommy Yummy, On Kim Pot Rice, Bashi Ramen, Dimpot, Dumpling Station, King Fong Bing Teng, Bingle Bingle, Tori Yoichi, Hing Gor Beef Brisket, TOKENYO Korean BBQ Cuisine, Sing Kee Seafood Restaurant, ManShan Taiwan, Rice Rule, TOKENYO 및 기타 브랜드. 또한 케이터링 서비스, 식사, 테이크아웃 및 음식 배달을 제공할 뿐만 아니라 디지털 주문, 멤버십 및 프로모션을 위한 통합 모바일 애플리케이션인 Tai Hing Group App을 운영합니다. 이 회사는 1989년에 설립되었으며 홍콩 쿼리 베이에 본사를 두고 있습니다. Tai Hing Group Holdings Limited는 Chun Fat Company Limited의 자회사로 운영됩니다.
